frames.text:
Usage: aeat config profile history [OPTIONS] [profile]

  Show the append-only event history for one profile

Arguments:
  profile  Profile name whose event history should be inspected

Options:
  --event-type <str>              Filter the history to one or more event
                                  types (repeatable)
  --since <str>                   Filter the history to events at or after
                                  this ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g.
                                  2026-04-01T00:00:00+00:00)
  --until <str>                   Filter the history to events at or before
                                  this ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g.
                                  2026-04-30T23:59:59+00:00)
  --object-id <str>               Filter the history to events targeting a
                                  specific object_id (exact match)
  --actor <str>                   Filter the history to events recorded by a
                                  specific actor (exact match)
  --output-language, --language <es|en|ca|hu>
                                  Output language for the response text (es,
                                  en, ca, hu).
  --install-completion            Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion               Show completion for the current shell, to
                                  copy it or customize the installation.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
